entries.definition: pharmacy 多指医院或街边配处方药的药房，也指药学专业。英式英语中 chemist's 更口语；美式英语中 drugstore 可兼卖零食，但药房本身仍是 pharmacy。注意：去药店买药常说 go to the pharmacy。

examples.en: I need to stop by the pharmacy to pick up my prescription before it closes.
examples.zh: 我得在药店关门前去取我的处方药。

examples.en: The pharmacist at the pharmacy gave me something for my cold and told me to take it twice a day.
examples.zh: 药店的药剂师给了我治感冒的药，并让我每天吃两次。

entries.shortAnswer: Pharmacy 的中文意思是「药店」，即配药、卖药的地方。它与 drugstore 的关键区别在于：pharmacy 更强调配处方药的专业场所，而 drugstore 在美式英语中常兼卖日用品。
entries.definition: Pharmacy 的核心词义是药店和药学。常见搭配有 at the pharmacy、pharmacy counter。正式场合指医院药房或药学专业；口语中可与 drugstore 换用，但 drugstore 更像便利店式药店。注意拼写，勿与 farmacy 混淆。

examples.en: I need to stop by the pharmacy to pick up my prescription before it closes.
examples.zh: 我得在药店关门前去取我的处方药。

examples.en: The pharmacist at the pharmacy gave me something for my cold and told me to take it twice a day.
examples.zh: 药店的药剂师给了我治感冒的药，并让我每天吃两次。

entries.shortAnswer: 「急救」的英文是 first aid，指在专业医疗人员到达前，对伤病者进行的紧急初步救护与处理。
entries.definition: first aid 是不可数名词，常见搭配有 give first aid、a first-aid kit、first-aid training；作定语时通常加连字符。

examples.en: She took a first-aid course so she could help her students if they got hurt.
examples.zh: 她参加了急救课程，这样学生受伤时她就能帮上忙。

examples.en: The hiker broke his ankle, and his friend gave him first aid until the rescue team arrived.
examples.zh: 那位徒步者脚踝骨折，他的朋友给他做了急救，直到救援队赶到。

entries.shortAnswer: First aid means 急救: immediate, basic help given before professional medical treatment arrives.
entries.definition: First aid is an uncountable noun: give first aid, a first-aid kit, first-aid training. Use a hyphen before nouns.

examples.en: She took a first-aid course so she could help her students if they got hurt.
examples.zh: 她参加了急救课程，这样学生受伤时她就能帮上忙。

examples.en: The hiker broke his ankle, and his friend gave him first aid until the rescue team arrived.
examples.zh: 那位徒步者脚踝骨折，他的朋友给他做了急救，直到救援队赶到。

entries.shortAnswer: 「打疫苗」的英文是 get vaccinated，表示接种疫苗，强调完成接种这一动作。
entries.definition: get vaccinated 是固定搭配，意为打疫苗、接种疫苗。常见搭配：get vaccinated against + 疾病。注意：一般不说 get vaccine，也不说 take vaccine。

examples.en: You should get vaccinated against the flu before winter starts.
examples.zh: 你应该在冬天开始前打流感疫苗。

examples.en: She got vaccinated last week and only had a mild sore arm.
examples.zh: 她上周打了疫苗，只是手臂有点酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: get vaccinated 的中文意思是「打疫苗」，也就是接种疫苗，用来预防疾病。
entries.definition: get vaccinated 意为打疫苗、接种疫苗，常用于日常口语和公共卫生建议。常见搭配：get vaccinated against + 疾病名称。

examples.en: You should get vaccinated against the flu before winter starts.
examples.zh: 你应该在冬天开始前打流感疫苗。

examples.en: She got vaccinated last week and only had a mild sore arm.
examples.zh: 她上周打了疫苗，只是手臂有点酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「量体温」英文是 take one's temperature，如 The nurse took my temperature。
entries.definition: 动词短语，指用体温计测人体温度，one's 随主语变化，如 take my temperature，不说 take the temperature。

examples.en: The nurse took my temperature and said I had a slight fever.
examples.zh: 护士给我量了体温，说我有点发烧。

examples.en: You should take your temperature twice a day while you're sick.
examples.zh: 生病期间你应该每天量两次体温。

entries.shortAnswer: take one's temperature 意思是「量体温」，如 The nurse took my temperature。
entries.definition: verb phrase: to measure a person's body heat with a thermometer, usually with a possessive, as in take my temperature.

examples.en: The nurse took my temperature and said I had a slight fever.
examples.zh: 护士给我量了体温，说我有点发烧。

examples.en: You should take your temperature twice a day while you're sick.
examples.zh: 生病期间你应该每天量两次体温。

entries.shortAnswer: 「病假」的英文是 sick leave，指因生病而获准的休假。注意 sick leave 通常指有固定工作或学籍的人请的病假，且多带薪。
entries.definition: sick leave 为不可数名词，常见搭配有 on sick leave（在休病假）、take sick leave（请病假）、paid sick leave（带薪病假）。不要与 sick day（病假日）混用，sick leave 侧重获准的休假权利。

examples.en: She took a week of sick leave after catching a bad cold.
examples.zh: 她得了重感冒后请了一周病假。

examples.en: Employees are entitled to paid sick leave if they provide a doctor's note.
examples.zh: 如果提供医生证明，员工有权享受带薪病假。

entries.shortAnswer: sick leave 的中文意思是「病假」，指因生病而获准的休假。与 sick day 不同，sick leave 更正式，常指工作或学校中有固定天数的带薪病假。
entries.definition: sick leave 为不可数名词，正式用语，常见搭配有 on sick leave、take sick leave、paid sick leave。注意不要与 sick day（一天病假）混淆，sick leave 通常指一段获准的休假时间。

examples.en: She took a week of sick leave after catching a bad cold.
examples.zh: 她得了重感冒后请了一周病假。

examples.en: Employees are entitled to paid sick leave if they provide a doctor's note.
examples.zh: 如果提供医生证明，员工有权享受带薪病假。

entries.shortAnswer: 「在家休养」的英文是 recover at home，指生病或手术后在家恢复健康。注意 recover 强调恢复过程，不是简单的「休息」。
entries.definition: recover at home 常与 from 连用，如 recover from a cold at home。易错点：不说 rest at home 表示「休养」，rest 只强调休息，不含康复义。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to recover at home for a week after the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生建议他手术后在家休养一周。

examples.en: She caught a cold and decided to recover at home instead of going to work.
examples.zh: 她感冒了，决定在家休养而不去上班。

entries.shortAnswer: 「recover at home」的中文意思是「在家休养」，指在家恢复健康。与 get better 相比，recover 更正式，强调从疾病中完全康复。
entries.definition: recover at home 表示在家康复，常用于医生建议或病后描述。搭配 recover from illness/surgery at home。口语中也可说 get better at home，但 recover 更正式。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to recover at home for a week after the surgery.
examples.zh: 医生建议他手术后在家休养一周。

examples.en: She caught a cold and decided to recover at home instead of going to work.
examples.zh: 她感冒了，决定在家休养而不去上班。

entries.shortAnswer: 「腰酸背痛」最常用的英文说法是 sore back，指腰背部酸痛不适。注意 sore back 侧重肌肉酸痛，若想强调「僵硬」可用 stiff back。
entries.definition: sore back 是口语和书面都常用的表达，可搭配 have a sore back、get a sore back。若指持续性腰背痛，医生可能用 back pain 或 lower back pain，sore 更偏「酸痛、一碰就痛」。

examples.en: I played basketball for three hours yesterday, so now I have a sore back.
examples.zh: 我昨天打了三个小时篮球，所以现在腰酸背痛。

examples.en: Sitting at a desk all day can give you a sore back, so remember to stand up and stretch.
examples.zh: 整天坐在桌前会让你腰酸背痛，所以记得站起来伸展一下。

entries.shortAnswer: sore back 的中文意思是「腰酸背痛」，指腰背部肌肉酸痛、僵硬不适。它强调酸痛感，而 back pain 更泛指任何腰背疼痛，包括伤病引起的剧痛。
entries.definition: sore back 是日常英语，常与 have、get、a 连用，如 I have a sore back。正式医学语境多用 back pain 或 lower back pain。注意 sore 不可直接说成 pain，sore 指酸痛、触痛。

examples.en: I played basketball for three hours yesterday, so now I have a sore back.
examples.zh: 我昨天打了三个小时篮球，所以现在腰酸背痛。

examples.en: Sitting at a desk all day can give you a sore back, so remember to stand up and stretch.
examples.zh: 整天坐在桌前会让你腰酸背痛，所以记得站起来伸展一下。

entries.shortAnswer: 「量血压」的英文是 check blood pressure，check 表示测量，blood pressure 指血压。
entries.definition: check blood pressure 意为量血压，check 后常接 one's，如 check my blood pressure。日常口语中比 measure 更自然。

examples.en: The nurse will check blood pressure for every patient before the appointment.
examples.zh: 护士会在预约前给每位病人量血压。

examples.en: If you have hypertension, check blood pressure regularly.
examples.zh: 如果你有高血压，要定期量血压。

entries.shortAnswer: To check blood pressure 的中文意思是「量血压」，也就是测量血压。
entries.definition: check blood pressure means to measure blood pressure. It often takes one's, as in check my blood pressure.

examples.en: The nurse will check blood pressure for every patient before the appointment.
examples.zh: 护士会在预约前给每位病人量血压。

examples.en: If you have hypertension, check blood pressure regularly.
examples.zh: 如果你有高血压，要定期量血压。

entries.shortAnswer: 「难过」常用 down 表达，尤其指情绪低落、提不起劲，偏口语。注意 down 语气较轻，程度重、持续久时多用 depressed。
entries.definition: down 多作表语，搭配 feel/be down、a bit down、feel a little down。它指短暂的情绪低落，不等于临床抑郁 depressed；比 sad 更口语、更含蓄。名词形式 the downs 可指低落期。

examples.en: She's been a bit down since she failed the exam.
examples.zh: 自从考试没及格，她一直有点难过。

examples.en: I felt really down after saying goodbye to my best friend.
examples.zh: 和最好的朋友道别后，我感到非常难过。

entries.shortAnswer: down 的中文意思是「难过、情绪低落」，多作表语，偏口语。它指短暂的心情不好，比 sad 含蓄，和临床抑郁 depressed 程度不同。
entries.definition: down 常与 feel、be、a bit、a little 连用，如 feel down、be a bit down。它强调暂时低落，非医学诊断；depressed 程度更重、更持久。口语中也可说 feeling blue。

examples.en: She's been a bit down since she failed the exam.
examples.zh: 自从考试没及格，她一直有点难过。

examples.en: I felt really down after saying goodbye to my best friend.
examples.zh: 和最好的朋友道别后，我感到非常难过。

entries.shortAnswer: 「心情好」的英文是 in a good mood，表示此刻情绪愉快、状态轻松，强调当下感受而非长期性格。
entries.definition: in a good mood 多作表语，如 be/feel in a good mood，表示眼下心情愉快。偏口语；正式可说 in good spirits。反义为 in a bad mood。

examples.en: She is in a good mood today, so it is a good time to ask her for help.
examples.zh: 她今天心情好，所以现在找她帮忙正合适。

examples.en: The children were in a good mood after the picnic and sang all the way home.
examples.zh: 野餐之后孩子们心情好，一路唱着歌回家。

entries.shortAnswer: in a good mood 的中文意思是「心情好」，指此刻情绪愉快、心态轻松，只说明当前状态，不指长期性格。
entries.definition: in a good mood 是口语常用表达，作表语，如 be/feel in a good mood，只说明当下心情不错，不同于长期乐观的 cheerful。反义为 in a bad mood。

examples.en: She is in a good mood today, so it is a good time to ask her for help.
examples.zh: 她今天心情好，所以现在找她帮忙正合适。

examples.en: The children were in a good mood after the picnic and sang all the way home.
examples.zh: 野餐之后孩子们心情好，一路唱着歌回家。

entries.shortAnswer: 烦躁的英文是 irritated，指因小事而恼火、不耐烦。注意它与 angry 程度不同：irritated 更轻，常因反复打扰或琐事引起。
entries.definition: irritated 侧重被反复打扰后的不耐烦，比 angry 轻，比 annoyed 略强。常见搭配：get/feel irritated by/with，irritated at sth，irritating 形容事物令人烦躁。

examples.en: She gets irritated when people talk loudly on the phone in public.
examples.zh: 有人在公共场合大声打电话时，她会很烦躁。

examples.en: I was irritated by the constant noise from the construction site next door.
examples.zh: 隔壁工地没完没了的噪音让我很烦躁。

entries.shortAnswer: irritated 的中文意思是烦躁，指因小事而恼火、不耐烦。它比 angry 程度轻，强调被反复打扰后的反应。
entries.definition: irritated 指因琐事或反复打扰而恼火，比 angry 轻，比 annoyed 略强。常用搭配：be/feel/get irritated by/with sb/sth，irritated at doing sth。口语中常与 slightly、really 连用。

examples.en: She gets irritated when people talk loudly on the phone in public.
examples.zh: 有人在公共场合大声打电话时，她会很烦躁。

examples.en: I was irritated by the constant noise from the construction site next door.
examples.zh: 隔壁工地没完没了的噪音让我很烦躁。

entries.shortAnswer: 「压力大」英语常说是 stressed out，比单纯 stressed 更强调被压得身心俱疲。口语中常用 be/feel stressed out，也可说 get stressed out。
entries.definition: stressed out 指因工作、考试或生活琐事而焦虑紧张、快扛不住了，程度比 stressed 重，偏口语。常搭配 be/feel/get stressed out about sth；注意它不等于临床抑郁 depressed。

examples.en: I've been really stressed out lately because of the deadline and I can't sleep well.
examples.zh: 最近因为截止日期我压力大得厉害，觉都睡不好。

examples.en: She gets stressed out every time she has to speak in front of a big crowd.
examples.zh: 每次要在一大群人面前讲话，她都会压力大得不行。

entries.shortAnswer: Stressed out 的中文意思是「压力大」，形容紧张焦虑、快受不了的状态。它比 stressed 语气更强，更口语化，不等于临床意义的 depressed。
entries.definition: stressed out 表示因压力而焦虑疲惫，常用于口语和非正式场合，如 feel/get/be stressed out about work。想表达长期情绪低落可用 down 或 feeling blue，临床抑郁才用 depressed。

examples.en: I've been really stressed out lately because of the deadline and I can't sleep well.
examples.zh: 最近因为截止日期我压力大得厉害，觉都睡不好。

examples.en: She gets stressed out every time she has to speak in front of a big crowd.
examples.zh: 每次要在一大群人面前讲话，她都会压力大得不行。

entries.shortAnswer: 中文「生气」最常译为 angry，语气可轻可重，强烈时可用 furious，日常口语也说 mad。
entries.definition: angry 是最通用的词，指一时恼怒或持续愤怒，搭配 be angry with sb、be angry at/about sth，不表示委屈或失望。

examples.en: She was angry with her brother for breaking her phone.
examples.zh: 她因为弟弟弄坏了她的手机而生气。

examples.en: He gets angry when people don't listen to him.
examples.zh: 别人不听他说话时，他就会生气。

entries.shortAnswer: English angry means「生气」，强调因不公或挫折而发怒，比 annoyed 强，口语常用 mad 或 cross。
entries.definition: angry 指因受冒犯、挫折或不公而发怒，搭配 angry with sb、angry about sth，口语也可说 mad 或 cross。

examples.en: She was angry with her brother for breaking her phone.
examples.zh: 她因为弟弟弄坏了她的手机而生气。

examples.en: He gets angry when people don't listen to him.
examples.zh: 别人不听他说话时，他就会生气。

entries.shortAnswer: 「感动」最常用的英文是 touched，例如 I was deeply touched。注意 touched 强调因善意而心头一暖，与 excited（兴奋）或 moved to tears（感动落泪）程度不同。
entries.definition: touched 常与 be/feel 连用，如 be touched by sb's kindness，表示因他人善意而内心温暖。注意区分：moved 更强调被情感打动，可指悲伤或震撼；touched 侧重感激与温情，口语和书面均常用。

examples.en: I was deeply touched by the thoughtful gift from my students.
examples.zh: 我被学生们贴心的礼物深深感动了。

examples.en: She felt touched when her friend remembered her birthday and sent a handwritten card.
examples.zh: 当朋友记得她的生日并寄来手写卡片时，她感到很感动。

entries.shortAnswer: touched 的中文是「感动」，指因他人的善意或关怀而心头温暖。与 moved 不同，touched 更强调感激和温情，而非悲伤或震撼。
entries.definition: touched 作形容词，意为「受感动」，常见搭配有 be/feel touched by sth。多用于因他人善举、礼物或关怀而心生暖意的场合，正式与口语皆可。注意不要与 touched 的动词原义「触摸」混淆。

examples.en: I was deeply touched by the thoughtful gift from my students.
examples.zh: 我被学生们贴心的礼物深深感动了。

examples.en: She felt touched when her friend remembered her birthday and sent a handwritten card.
examples.zh: 当朋友记得她的生日并寄来手写卡片时，她感到很感动。

entries.shortAnswer: 「委屈」的英文是 feeling wronged，指觉得自己被冤枉、被亏待却难以说清。它强调的是一种不被公正对待的酸楚感。
entries.definition: feeling wronged 多作表语，如 feel wronged、be left feeling wronged；口语也可说 feel hard done by。注意它不是 sad，重点在「被亏待、不被公平对待」，常与 helpless、upset 连用。

examples.en: She left the meeting feeling wronged, convinced that no one had listened to her side of the story.
examples.zh: 她开完会离开时满心委屈，认定没有人听她那一面的说法。

examples.en: He tried not to sound like a child feeling wronged, but his voice still trembled with hurt.
examples.zh: 他尽量不让自己听起来像个受了委屈的孩子，但声音还是因伤心而发颤。

entries.shortAnswer: Feeling wronged 的中文意思是「委屈」，指觉得自己被冤枉或不公平对待而心里难受。它与 sad 不同，重点在「遭到不公正对待」的委屈感。
entries.definition: feeling wronged 表示因被冤枉、被亏待而委屈，常作表语：feel / be left feeling wronged。口语近义说法是 feel hard done by；不要与 disappointed（失望）、depressed（抑郁）混用。

examples.en: She left the meeting feeling wronged, convinced that no one had listened to her side of the story.
examples.zh: 她开完会离开时满心委屈，认定没有人听她那一面的说法。

examples.en: He tried not to sound like a child feeling wronged, but his voice still trembled with hurt.
examples.zh: 他尽量不让自己听起来像个受了委屈的孩子，但声音还是因伤心而发颤。

entries.shortAnswer: 「焦虑」常译作 anxious，be anxious about sth 表示对某事焦虑不安；也可说 feel anxious。
entries.definition: anxious 指焦虑的、担心的，常用 be anxious about sth 或 feel anxious；也可表示渴望的，如 be anxious to do sth，需靠搭配区分。名词是 anxiety。

examples.en: She felt anxious about the job interview all week.
examples.zh: 她整个星期都为那场求职面试感到焦虑。

examples.en: He was anxious to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他急于在截止日期前完成那份报告。

entries.shortAnswer: anxious 的中文常译「焦虑的」，指对可能发生的事感到不安，也可表示「渴望的」。
entries.definition: anxious 语气介于 nervous 与 afraid 之间，多指对未来不确定的事忧心，常见搭配 be anxious about sth、feel anxious。注意 be anxious to do sth 意为渴望做某事，名词为 anxiety。

examples.en: She felt anxious about the job interview all week.
examples.zh: 她整个星期都为那场求职面试感到焦虑。

examples.en: He was anxious to finish the report before the deadline.
examples.zh: 他急于在截止日期前完成那份报告。

entries.shortAnswer: 「嫉妒」的英文是 jealous。它常指因别人拥有自己渴望的东西而心生不满，与羡慕(envy)不同，嫉妒带有更强的负面情绪。
entries.definition: jealous 多用于感情关系或比较场景，如 be jealous of sb/sth。注意：envy 侧重「羡慕」，jealous 则常含「怕失去」或「怨恨」意味，如 a jealous husband。

examples.en: She felt jealous when she saw her ex-boyfriend with someone new.
examples.zh: 看到前男友有了新欢，她感到嫉妒。

examples.en: He was jealous of his colleague's promotion, even though he tried to hide it.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒同事升职，尽管他试图掩饰。

entries.shortAnswer: 「jealous」的中文意思是「嫉妒」。它强调因他人拥有自己看重的东西而心生不快，常含猜忌或怕失去的意味。
entries.definition: jealous 可指因感情、成就等而嫉妒，搭配 be jealous of。与 envious 不同，jealous 更强调「怕失去」或「怨恨」，如 a jealous look。口语中也可说 feeling jealous。

examples.en: She felt jealous when she saw her ex-boyfriend with someone new.
examples.zh: 看到前男友有了新欢，她感到嫉妒。

examples.en: He was jealous of his colleague's promotion, even though he tried to hide it.
examples.zh: 他嫉妒同事升职，尽管他试图掩饰。

entries.shortAnswer: 「尴尬」的英文是 embarrassed，形容因失态或出错而不自在、难为情，相当于中文的不好意思。
entries.definition: embarrassed 多作表语：be/feel/look embarrassed，用 about/at/by 引出原因。它修饰人，修饰事要用 embarrassing（令人尴尬的）。

examples.en: She was embarrassed when she forgot his name in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 她在众人面前忘了他名字，感到很尴尬。

examples.en: I felt embarrassed about asking such a silly question.
examples.zh: 问了个这么傻的问题，我觉得挺尴尬的。

entries.shortAnswer: embarrassed 的中文意思是「尴尬、难为情」，指因失态或出错而不好意思，多用来形容人的感受。
entries.definition: embarrassed 常作表语：be/feel/look embarrassed，后接 about/at/by 说明原因。修饰事物用 embarrassing，别用 embarrassed。

examples.en: She was embarrassed when she forgot his name in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 她在众人面前忘了他名字，感到很尴尬。

examples.en: I felt embarrassed about asking such a silly question.
examples.zh: 问了个这么傻的问题，我觉得挺尴尬的。

entries.shortAnswer: 害羞的英文是 shy，指在社交场合感到紧张、不自在。注意 shy 更侧重因胆怯而回避社交，而 embarrassed 更多指因尴尬而难为情。
entries.definition: shy 可作形容词，常见搭配：be shy with strangers（见生人害羞）、a shy smile（羞怯的微笑）。名词形式为 shyness。注意 shy 与 ashamed 不同：前者是性格倾向，后者是因过错感到羞愧。

examples.en: Don't be shy; just come up and say hello.
examples.zh: 别害羞，过来打个招呼吧。

examples.en: She was too shy to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她太害羞了，不敢在全班同学面前发言。

entries.shortAnswer: shy 的中文意思是害羞，指在社交场合容易紧张、不自在。与 embarrassed 不同，shy 更强调性格上的胆怯和回避，而非因尴尬产生的难为情。
entries.definition: shy 作形容词，常见搭配：be shy about doing sth（对做某事感到害羞）、a shy person（害羞的人）。口语中也可用 shy 表示「不足的」，如 shy of funds。名词形式为 shyness。

examples.en: Don't be shy; just come up and say hello.
examples.zh: 别害羞，过来打个招呼吧。

examples.en: She was too shy to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她太害羞了，不敢在全班同学面前发言。

entries.shortAnswer: 兴奋的英文是 excited，指对即将发生的事感到激动、期待。注意 excited 只形容人，形容事情令人兴奋要用 exciting。
entries.definition: excited 常搭配 be excited about / at / to do sth，如 excited about the trip。它形容人主观的激动情绪；若说某事本身令人兴奋，须用 exciting，这是中国学习者最常见的错用。

examples.en: The kids were so excited about the trip that they couldn't sleep.
examples.zh: 孩子们对这次旅行兴奋得睡不着觉。

examples.en: I'm excited to hear your good news — tell me everything!
examples.zh: 听到你的好消息我很兴奋，快全告诉我！

entries.shortAnswer: excited 的中文意思是兴奋，指人因期待好事而情绪高涨。它只形容人的感受，形容事物令人兴奋要用 exciting。
entries.definition: excited 表示人因期待或好事临近而激动，常见搭配 be excited about / to do sth。偏口语和日常，正式场合可用 thrilled。注意主语必须是人，别用它来形容事件本身。

examples.en: The kids were so excited about the trip that they couldn't sleep.
examples.zh: 孩子们对这次旅行兴奋得睡不着觉。

examples.en: I'm excited to hear your good news — tell me everything!
examples.zh: 听到你的好消息我很兴奋，快全告诉我！

entries.shortAnswer: 「安心」最常用的英文是 relieved，常指悬着的心放下了。它强调先前的担心或压力消失，不是单纯的平静或放心。
entries.definition: relieved 多作表语，搭配 feel/be/look relieved、be relieved to do sth、be relieved that...，侧重忧虑解除后的轻松；比 calm、safe 更强调担忧消失。

examples.en: I felt relieved when the doctor said everything was fine.
examples.zh: 医生说一切正常时，我感到很安心。

examples.en: She was relieved to hear that her flight had not been cancelled.
examples.zh: 听说航班没有取消，她松了一口气。

entries.shortAnswer: relieved 的中文常译为「安心」，表示担心或压力解除后的宽慰。它强调从紧张、忧虑中放松下来，不是单纯的 calm 或 relaxed。
entries.definition: relieved 是形容词，表示宽慰的、安心的，常用 feel/be/look relieved、be relieved to do sth、be relieved that...；口语和书面都常见，比 relaxed 多一层「原本担心，现在放心」的意味。

examples.en: I felt relieved when the doctor said everything was fine.
examples.zh: 医生说一切正常时，我感到很安心。

examples.en: She was relieved to hear that her flight had not been cancelled.
examples.zh: 听说航班没有取消，她松了一口气。

entries.shortAnswer: 「失望」的英文是 disappointed，指期待落空后的难过，多用来描述人的感受。
entries.definition: disappointed 常搭配 be/feel disappointed at/about/with sth，对某人失望则用 disappointed in sb，比 down 更指向具体事由。

examples.en: She looked disappointed when she heard the trip had been canceled.
examples.zh: 听说旅行取消了，她看上去很失望。

examples.en: I was really disappointed in myself for giving up so easily.
examples.zh: 我为自己那么轻易就放弃而深感失望。

entries.shortAnswer: disappointed 的中文意思是「失望」，指期望未实现时的难过，比 down 更指向具体事由。
entries.definition: disappointed 作形容词，常见搭配 be/feel disappointed at/about/with sth 和 disappointed in sb，名词形式为 disappointment。

examples.en: She looked disappointed when she heard the trip had been canceled.
examples.zh: 听说旅行取消了，她看上去很失望。

examples.en: I was really disappointed in myself for giving up so easily.
examples.zh: 我为自己那么轻易就放弃而深感失望。

entries.shortAnswer: 「紧张」最常用的英文是 nervous，侧重因担心而心神不宁。注意：nervous 多指内心不安，而“紧张局势”要用 tense，别说成 nervous situation。
entries.definition: nervous 形容人感到紧张、焦虑，常搭配 be nervous about（对…紧张）、get nervous（变得紧张）。说“别紧张”是 Don't be nervous.；若描述气氛或局势紧张，则用 tense，如 a tense atmosphere。

examples.en: I always get nervous before a job interview.
examples.zh: 我面试前总是很紧张。

examples.en: She felt nervous about speaking in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 她想到要在全班面前发言就感到紧张。

entries.shortAnswer: nervous 的中文意思是“紧张”，指因担忧而不安。它侧重人的心理状态，与 tense 不同，tense 多形容气氛、关系或肌肉的紧绷。
entries.definition: nervous 表示紧张、焦虑，常搭配 be/get nervous about sth，口语中也可说 feel nervous。注意：nervous 指人的情绪，而 tense 形容局势或气氛紧张；nervous 还有“神经的”专业义，如 nervous system。

examples.en: I always get nervous before a job interview.
examples.zh: 我面试前总是很紧张。

examples.en: She felt nervous about speaking in front of the whole class.
examples.zh: 她想到要在全班面前发言就感到紧张。

entries.shortAnswer: 「无聊」常说 bored，指人感到厌烦、提不起兴趣；事物令人无聊则用 boring。
entries.definition: bored 多作表语：be/get/feel bored，后接 with 或 of 表示对某事厌倦。口语可说 bored stiff、bored to death，或 fed up。

examples.en: The kids got bored waiting for the train, so they played games on their phones.
examples.zh: 孩子们等火车等得无聊，就开始用手机玩游戏。

examples.en: I'm bored with the same routine every day and want to try something new.
examples.zh: 我厌倦了每天一成不变的生活，想尝试点新东西。

entries.shortAnswer: Bored means 无聊: feeling tired and impatient because you have nothing interesting to do.
entries.definition: Bored is an adjective, usually after be/get/feel, often with with or of. For a dull thing, use boring, not bored.

examples.en: The kids got bored waiting for the train, so they played games on their phones.
examples.zh: 孩子们等火车等得无聊，就开始用手机玩游戏。

examples.en: I'm bored with the same routine every day and want to try something new.
examples.zh: 我厌倦了每天一成不变的生活，想尝试点新东西。

entries.shortAnswer: 「崩溃」的英文是 have a meltdown，指情绪突然失控、当众发火或大哭，比 be upset 重得多。
entries.definition: have a meltdown 强调情绪瞬间失控，常见搭配 have a complete meltdown、emotional meltdown。口语常用，比 break down 更夸张，说「我快崩溃了」多用 I'm about to have a meltdown。

examples.en: She had a complete meltdown when she realized she'd lost her passport.
examples.zh: 当她发现护照丢了时，她彻底崩溃了。

examples.en: I'm so stressed about this deadline that I'm about to have a meltdown.
examples.zh: 这个截止日期让我压力太大，我快要崩溃了。

entries.shortAnswer: have a meltdown 的中文意思是「崩溃」，指情绪突然失控、大发脾气或大哭，比 be upset 重，也比 break down 更口语。
entries.definition: have a meltdown 指因压力或情绪过载而突然失控，常见搭配 have a complete/emotional meltdown。多用于口语，可指大人发脾气或孩子闹情绪，正式写作中更常用 break down。

examples.en: She had a complete meltdown when she realized she'd lost her passport.
examples.zh: 当她发现护照丢了时，她彻底崩溃了。

examples.en: I'm so stressed about this deadline that I'm about to have a meltdown.
examples.zh: 这个截止日期让我压力太大，我快要崩溃了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「释怀」的英文是 let it go，指放下耿耿于怀的情绪。注意它侧重不再纠结，而非忘记；let it go 常用于劝人别再计较一件已过去的事。
entries.definition: let it go 多用于口语劝解，意为不再纠结、放下心结，如 just let it go（就别再想了）。与 forgive（原谅对方）不同，释怀不一定要原谅，只是自己不再被这件事牵着走；I can't let it go 则相反，表示放不下。

examples.en: You did your best, so let it go and stop blaming yourself.
examples.zh: 你已经尽力了，就释怀吧，别再责怪自己了。

examples.en: It took her years to let it go after the argument with her sister.
examples.zh: 和姐姐吵过那一架之后，她花了好几年才释怀。

entries.shortAnswer: 「let it go」的中文意思是「释怀」，表示放下耿耿于怀的情绪。它与 forget（忘记）不同，是主动决定不再纠结，情绪上松手，但事情本身未必忘掉。
entries.definition: let it go 是口语短语，指对旧事不再计较、放下心结，如 let it go and move on。比 forgive 更强调自我解脱，不涉及对方；比 get over it 语气更温和，后者有时显得不耐烦。

examples.en: You did your best, so let it go and stop blaming yourself.
examples.zh: 你已经尽力了，就释怀吧，别再责怪自己了。

examples.en: It took her years to let it go after the argument with her sister.
examples.zh: 和姐姐吵过那一架之后，她花了好几年才释怀。

entries.shortAnswer: 「心碎」的英文是 heartbroken。它形容因失去爱人、被背叛或重大失望而感到极度悲伤，日常口语也常听到更轻的说法 down 或 feeling blue。
entries.definition: heartbroken 强调情感重创后的深度悲伤，常用搭配：be heartbroken over/about sb/sth、a heartbroken letter。注意它比 disappointed（失望）重得多；depressed 偏临床抑郁，不能随便互换。

examples.en: She was heartbroken when her boyfriend moved out without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 男朋友不辞而别搬走时，她心都碎了。

examples.en: He looked heartbroken at the funeral, but he tried to stay strong for his mother.
examples.zh: 葬礼上他看上去心碎不已，但还是努力为母亲撑住。

entries.shortAnswer: Heartbroken 的中文意思是「心碎」。它指因失恋、丧亲或被辜负而极度伤心，语气比 disappointed（失望）重得多，也不同于 clinical depressed（临床抑郁）。
entries.definition: heartbroken 是形容词，常见搭配：be heartbroken over/about sb/sth、a heartbroken parent。多用于感情破裂、失去亲人等重大打击，口语和书面都常见；不要用它轻描淡写地说「有点低落」。

examples.en: She was heartbroken when her boyfriend moved out without saying goodbye.
examples.zh: 男朋友不辞而别搬走时，她心都碎了。

examples.en: He looked heartbroken at the funeral, but he tried to stay strong for his mother.
examples.zh: 葬礼上他看上去心碎不已，但还是努力为母亲撑住。

entries.shortAnswer: 「沮丧」的英文常用说法是 feeling blue，口语化表达，指短暂情绪低落。
entries.definition: feeling blue 表示心情低落、闷闷不乐，多用于日常口语，常与 be、feel、look 连用；指短暂坏心情，非临床抑郁。

examples.en: I've been feeling blue all week because of the rainy weather.
examples.zh: 因为一直下雨，我这一周都觉得很沮丧。

examples.en: He looked a bit blue after hearing the news, so we took him out for coffee.
examples.zh: 听到那个消息后他显得有些沮丧，所以我们带他出去喝了杯咖啡。

entries.shortAnswer: Feeling blue means 沮丧 in Chinese: a casual way to say you feel sad or down.
entries.definition: Feeling blue is an informal way to say you are sad or in low spirits. Common with be, feel, look; not clinical depression.

examples.en: I've been feeling blue all week because of the rainy weather.
examples.zh: 因为一直下雨，我这一周都觉得很沮丧。

examples.en: He looked a bit blue after hearing the news, so we took him out for coffee.
examples.zh: 听到那个消息后他显得有些沮丧，所以我们带他出去喝了杯咖啡。

entries.shortAnswer: 「治愈」的英文是 soothing，多形容声音、气味或氛围令人放松、被安抚，听着或闻着心里就慢慢平静下来。
entries.definition: soothing 作形容词，常见搭配有 soothing music、a soothing voice，强调让人的情绪由紧绷转为平静，语气温和。

examples.en: She played some soothing music to help her roommate calm down after a rough day.
examples.zh: 室友难过了一整天，她放了些舒缓的音乐帮对方平静下来。

examples.en: The smell of chamomile tea is surprisingly soothing, especially when you are feeling blue.
examples.zh: 洋甘菊茶的香气出奇地治愈，尤其是在你情绪低落的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: soothing 的中文意思是「治愈」，形容令人放松、被安抚的声音、气味或氛围，能让人慢慢平静下来。
entries.definition: soothing 作形容词，常搭配 soothing music、a soothing voice，语气温和，多修饰事物，强调安抚情绪。

examples.en: She played some soothing music to help her roommate calm down after a rough day.
examples.zh: 室友难过了一整天，她放了些舒缓的音乐帮对方平静下来。

examples.en: The smell of chamomile tea is surprisingly soothing, especially when you are feeling blue.
examples.zh: 洋甘菊茶的香气出奇地治愈，尤其是在你情绪低落的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「想家」的英文是 homesick，表示离家后思念家人或家乡；注意常说 I am/feel homesick。
entries.definition: homesick 是形容词，指远离家乡或亲人时产生的思念与不适，常用 feel/be/get homesick，可用 a little 或 terribly 修饰。

examples.en: After three months abroad, she started to feel homesick and called her parents every day.
examples.zh: 在国外待了三个月后，她开始想家，每天给父母打电话。

examples.en: He gets homesick whenever he sees photos of his hometown on social media.
examples.zh: 每当他在社交媒体上看到家乡的照片，就会想家。

entries.shortAnswer: 「homesick」的中文意思是「想家」，指离家后思念家人或家乡，是常见的情绪反应。
entries.definition: homesick 是形容词，表示想家的、思乡的，常说 be/feel/get homesick，如 I feel homesick。

examples.en: After three months abroad, she started to feel homesick and called her parents every day.
examples.zh: 在国外待了三个月后，她开始想家，每天给父母打电话。

examples.en: He gets homesick whenever he sees photos of his hometown on social media.
examples.zh: 每当他在社交媒体上看到家乡的照片，就会想家。

entries.shortAnswer: 「满足」的英文是 content，表示对现状感到足够而内心平静满意，不再贪求更多。
entries.definition: content 表示「满足的、知足的」，常与 with 连用：be content with sth；也可说 content to do sth，强调内心平和、不贪求。

examples.en: After years of chasing promotions, she finally felt content with her simple life.
examples.zh: 在追逐升职多年后，她终于对自己简单的生活感到满足。

examples.en: He is content to stay home and read rather than go to the noisy party.
examples.zh: 他满足于待在家里读书，而不是去那个吵闹的派对。

entries.shortAnswer: content 的中文意思是「满足、知足」，形容对现状感到足够而不抱怨，内心平静安宁。
entries.definition: content 作形容词表示「满足的、知足的」，常搭配 be content with sth 或 content to do sth，强调平静知足、不贪求。

examples.en: After years of chasing promotions, she finally felt content with her simple life.
examples.zh: 在追逐升职多年后，她终于对自己简单的生活感到满足。

examples.en: He is content to stay home and read rather than go to the noisy party.
examples.zh: 他满足于待在家里读书，而不是去那个吵闹的派对。

entries.shortAnswer: 「期待」的英文是 be looking forward to it，表示满怀盼望地等待某事发生，比 expect 更强调积极愉快的心情。
entries.definition: be looking forward to it 用于表达对即将发生的好事感到兴奋、盼望，口语和书面皆可。注意 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词，如 looking forward to seeing you。

examples.en: I'm really looking forward to it because I haven't seen my best friend in years.
examples.zh: 我真的非常期待，因为我已经好几年没见到我最好的朋友了。

examples.en: She said she was looking forward to it, but her voice sounded a bit down.
examples.zh: 她说她很期待，但她的声音听起来有点低落。

entries.shortAnswer: be looking forward to it 的中文意思是「期待」，指对某事感到兴奋并盼望它发生，带有积极愉快的情感色彩。
entries.definition: be looking forward to it 表示热切盼望某事，常用于日常对话和邮件结尾。to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。常见搭配：look forward to hearing from you。

examples.en: I'm really looking forward to it because I haven't seen my best friend in years.
examples.zh: 我真的非常期待，因为我已经好几年没见到我最好的朋友了。

examples.en: She said she was looking forward to it, but her voice sounded a bit down.
examples.zh: 她说她很期待，但她的声音听起来有点低落。
